if(WIN32)
	set(WITH_OPENSSL "BUNDLED" CACHE STRING "OpenSSL mode: SYSTEM, BUNDLED" FORCE)
else()
	set(WITH_OPENSSL "BUNDLED" CACHE STRING "OpenSSL mode: SYSTEM, BUNDLED")
endif()
set_property(CACHE WITH_OPENSSL PROPERTY STRINGS SYSTEM BUNDLED)
if(NOT WITH_OPENSSL STREQUAL "SYSTEM" AND NOT WITH_OPENSSL STREQUAL "BUNDLED")
	message(FATAL_ERROR "WITH_OPENSSL must be SYSTEM or BUNDLED; OFF is not supported")
endif()

if(WIN32)
	set(WITH_POSTGRES "BUNDLED" CACHE STRING "Postgres mode: OFF, SYSTEM, BUNDLED" FORCE)
	set(WITH_MARIADB "BUNDLED" CACHE STRING "MariaDB mode: OFF, SYSTEM, BUNDLED" FORCE)
	set(WITH_MSSQL "BUNDLED" CACHE STRING "MSSQL mode: OFF, SYSTEM, BUNDLED" FORCE)
else()
	set(WITH_POSTGRES "BUNDLED" CACHE STRING "Postgres mode: OFF, SYSTEM, BUNDLED")
	set(WITH_MARIADB "BUNDLED" CACHE STRING "MariaDB mode: OFF, SYSTEM, BUNDLED")
	set(WITH_MSSQL "BUNDLED" CACHE STRING "MSSQL mode: OFF, SYSTEM, BUNDLED")
endif()
set_property(CACHE WITH_MSSQL PROPERTY STRINGS OFF SYSTEM BUNDLED)

if(WITH_POSTGRES STREQUAL "BUNDLED"
		OR WITH_MARIADB STREQUAL "BUNDLED"
		OR WITH_MSSQL STREQUAL "BUNDLED")
	add_subdirectory(openssl)
endif()

add_subdirectory(StormByte)
add_subdirectory(sqlite3)
add_subdirectory(postgres)
add_subdirectory(mariadb)
add_subdirectory(freetds)
